description: Read the hours the aerator had run when a trout farm's controller tripped it, from the single trip line of one day's journal. DISTILL-CANARY-41a9c358

files.README.md:
# Oakhanger Trout Farm - pond aerator

The farm runs one aerator on each of its ponds, and the aerator controller
appends a line to logs/aerator.log for every event it handles:

    <UTC time> <event> ...

RUN records the aerator starting up and the pond it serves. CHECK records the
oxygen reading the pond probe returned. TRIP is written once, when the
controller cuts the aerator out, and records the pond and the hours the aerator
had run since it was last serviced. The journal is closed with a line whose
count covers every event line above it.

2026-09-19T14:03:19Z CHECK pond=2 oxygen=8.6

2026-09-19T16:52:10Z CLOSE events=7

turns.prompt: Oakhanger Trout Farm runs an aerator on each of its ponds, and the aerator controller keeps a journal of what it does. The journal for 19 September 2026 covers the aerator starting up, the oxygen readings its probe returned and the one trip that cut the aerator out. For how many hours had the aerator run since it was last serviced when the controller tripped it? Give the number alone, as digits, with no label. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
